text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — dedicated pool 'hearthhealth-prod' showing GPU capacity exhaustion. Tenant allocation 98%, queueing rising. Paging @omar-oncall for immediate triage.

omar-oncall: On it. Pulling pool metrics and recent job history now.

ashley-infra: Looks like sustained A100 utilization, spike started ~07:38 UTC. Large batch retrain jobs overlapping with nightly inference shards.

micah-sre: Can we do an emergency burst to shared-hosted for low-priority shards? If burst buys time we can throttle batch jobs.

ashley-infra: Pool summary: ```
pool: hearthhealth-prod
nodes: 12 (A100)
utilization: 94-100%
queued_requests: 237
top_consumer: hearth-batch-retrain-job-7
```

ashley-infra: Kicking off burst request: ```
rictl dedicated burst enable --pool hearthhealth-prod --gpus 4 --ttl 15m
```
Requested to autoscaler, awaiting grant. :arrow_up_small:

ops-bot: Burst request accepted — +4 GPUs allocated to hearthhealth-prod. Autoscaler adjusted replica_count +2.

leah-csm: Notifying HearthHealth CSM and account team now. Recommending they pause non-critical retrains for 30m. I'll post the ask in their slack. :speech_balloon:

micah-sre: Also applying tenant QoS throttle for background batch jobs: ```
rictl tenant set-qos hearthhealth --batch-rate 20% --apply-now
```

ashley-infra: Throttle applied. Observing queue drain and tail latency improvement in 60s.

omar-oncall: Monitoring. If we hit 95% again, plan is: 1) drain long-running training pods (not serving), 2) evict lowest-priority inference replicas, 3) request extended burst or reserve. Assigning micah + ashley to execute steps.

micah-sre: Handoff ack — taking on-call for the night. Will maintain comms with CSM and account. ETA for stabilization ~30-45m if no new surges.

leah-csm: Customer agreed to pause retrains for 30m. They'll confirm when restarted.

ops-bot: Telemetry: queued_requests dropped from 237 -> 34 in 6m after burst + QoS. GPU utilization down to ~68%.

omar-oncall: Good progress. Leaving a note for followup: review autoscale thresholds and tenant QoS rules to avoid repeat. I'm marking this as mitigation-in-progress and handing off to micah for night. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Status update (mitigation in progress) — burst active, QoS applied. Next update in 15m. :hourglass:
